title: Large Diameter ViSiGi LUX ™ Gastric Sizing and Calibration System
official: Large Diameter ViSiGi LUX ™ Gastric Sizing and Calibration System Usability Study
summary: This study investigates the use of the large diameter ViSiGi LUX ™
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years or older
* Able to consent
* Candidate for laparoscopic gastric surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Esophageal stricture that does not allow passage of the device
* Conditions that would preclude gastric surgical procedures
* Pregnant patients
* Non-English-speaking patients
